instruction: Approve all pending venmo payment requests I have received in this month, and withdraw the remaining venmo balance, if any, to my card ending in 8907.
notes: Single-app (venmo) task. Pending requests are discovered by one listing call (requests-listed) filtered by status=pending; the agent must additionally keep only those created in May 2023 (received-this-month marks them; request-from-april is a distractor the goal never requires). Approvals are paid from the venmo balance (no payment_card_id), so each approve invalidates the balance reading (balance-fresh) and the balance-zero flag; withdrawal therefore must follow a fresh show_venmo_balance taken after the last approval, and complete_task requires balance-zero so the withdrawal is the final money movement. Card id comes from show_payment_cards (cards-listed) and the goal fixes the target card ending in 8907. The number of qualifying requests (2) is an assumption matching the 9-call reference; complete_task takes the two request records and the card record as non-API record parameters so its precondition equals the goal. The model assumes a positive remaining balance (the evaluation expects a card update).
